==Trivia==
This event is called "NEBULA_WEAPONS_TRADER" in the datafiles. 
* If the trader cheated you, the lost 45 scrap won't be refunded even if you then attack and win the fight against him.
* Enemy {{tooltip|ship|PIRATE}}<!-- events_ships.xml --> has 50% chance to offer a [[Rewards#Stuff|surrender]] at {{tooltip|30-40%|actual in-game value may be 3-4 hull + additional hull adjusted by sector progression}} hull and/or 50% chance for escape attempt at {{tooltip|20-40%|actual in-game value may be 2-4 hull + additional hull adjusted by sector progression}} hull.
